title: Willie preferred the Apollo to the road
summary: The band mostly entertained and Willie did not want to tour, preferring Apollo and Savoy hosting; road work did not pay much more.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

arrangement on "Three Little Words" -- the piano player.
I didn't have any solos like that, because the band
just I guess was primarily entertaining. All Willie...
Well, there was a big complaint. Willie didn't want to go
on the road too much. We just forced him one time, to get
away from the Apollo Theatre, you know... Boy, he was at
home there, because of... If the band would be working at
the Savoy, he'd be down there introducing acts!

Would you get more money when you went on the road?
Well, it would cost you more, wouldn't it...
Yeah, it wouldn't be that much more.

Not that much. So actually, it was just as good for
you to stay in the Savoy, was it?

Yeah. Unless you wanted to break the
monotony, you know, of the same...

At that age you would, probably. You'd want to get
out...
